notes.title: Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator is out of Early Access!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After months of hard work, I’m excited to announce that [b]Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator[/b] is out of early access!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/d9658e4e1d4e4c67699bfae7465a67cf3cb496b4.png[/img]

Here’s what this major update includes:

[list]
[*] Added a new case - The Possession of Olivia
[*] Added new jumpscares
[*] Added bug fixes related to capturing photos
[*] Added bug fixes related to recording audios
[*] Added bug fixes related to jumpscares not triggering
[*] Added bug fixes related to floating furniture jumpscares
[*] Added bug fixes related to unreachable objective items
[*] Increased game ambient brightness
[*] Enhanced crucifix animations
[*] Reduced monster and demon chase speed
[*] Enhanced the demon character models
[*] Updated initial screens
[*] Updated the how to play board
[*] Updated the exorcist bootcamp
[*] Updated journal
[*] Updated translations
[*] Updated and enhanced various sounds
[/list]

I want to thank every member of my growing community—especially those who believed in the game when I first announced it. If you haven’t already, you can join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/9XB2radzmv]Discord[/url]!

Over the past three months of early access, Unpossess has been played by more than 20,000 players.

A huge thank you to everyone who helped hunt down bugs and to all the content creators who shared clips of the game across different platforms. It’s been amazing watching you play while I continued working on new content!

Version 1.0 doesn’t mean updates will stop. I’ll be actively fixing bugs, tweaking game mechanics, and I’m already planning new jumpscares and new cases to keep things fresh. 

Please, if you encounter any bugs, report them on the Steam Community Hub or Discord. And if you have ideas, keep them coming—this game has been shaped by your feedback!

Enjoy and have fun!

Chreseeba

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/02aa8575f4c5371f74d947c3bc921b18e96d0f00.png[/img]

A customization desk will be added to the lobby, allowing you to spend your hard-earned funds on customizing your equipment.

In addition to these new features, I’m also working on another batch of bug fixes—plus some fresh jumpscares to keep things exciting!

[b]If you enjoy Unpossess, please consider leaving a positive Steam review—it helps support and motivate me! Constructive feedback is always welcome.[/b]

See you soon!

- chreseeba (Solo Developer)

notes.title: Developer Statement
notes.content:
Hello Steam Community,

I’m Chreseeba, the solo developer behind Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator.

First and foremost, I want to thank every one of you for playing, streaming, and supporting the game. Watching your gameplay, especially seeing streamers wear priestly attire for the experience, has been an absolute joy and a huge personal milestone for me.

The game is currently sitting at [b]Mixed [/b] reviews, and I’d like to address this with an open heart. I understand that not everyone may enjoy the game, and that’s okay. However, I kindly ask for constructive feedback in your reviews. As a solo developer, I’ve poured my heart and soul into Unpossess. Constructive criticism helps me improve the game, while positive reviews and sharing what you love about it can help others discover it too!

Here are a few things I’d like to clarify:

The game’s code is fully custom-made—no templates were used. As a passionate horror fan, I’ve built this game from the ground up.

While I don’t yet have the budget for tailor-made models and assets, I aim to incorporate them in the future.

Most of the bugs reported by the community have already been addressed, and I’m committed to making Unpossess the best it can be with your help and ideas.

I’ve just released a new patch: Early Access Version 1.4.4, which includes:

[list]
[*] Enhanced multiplayer animations
[*] Fixed the holy item placement bug
[*] Resolved a crash issue between the lobby and cases
[/list]
[b]Additionally, new content is on the horizon! A brand-new case is currently in development, and I can’t wait to share it with you.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/0fdcd3ebb5b165f411d34df20d0e8395d5aa223b.png[/img]

If you’d like to contribute to the game’s evolution, report bugs, or suggest features, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9XB2radzmv]Discord[/url] community. Your feedback is invaluable, and together, we can make Unpossess even better.

Thank you again for your support, and I look forward to seeing more of your exorcism adventures!

Warm regards,
[b]Chreseeba
Solo Developer of Unpossess: Exorcism Simulator[/b]

notes.title: Unpossess releases 10th January 2025
notes.content:
Mark Your Calendars: [b]Unpossess Launches January 10, 2025![/b]

Step into the early 1900s and embrace the role of an exorcist in Unpossess, a 1-4 player cooperative exorcism simulator. Inspired by classic supernatural films, this immersive game challenges players to confront and banish demonic entities in gripping, case-by-case missions.

Whether you face the darkness solo or join forces with fellow demonologists, the fate of the possessed rests in your hands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45019950/eebb8b05de19e2b527eb5a4ef890e55672664707.png[/img]

Prepare to exorcise evil like never before!

- Chreseeba (Solo developer)
